note: Cloudflare's published edge ranges (https://www.cloudflare.com/ips-v4 and /ips-v6, fetched 2026-10-26). A client set to trust_proxy 'cloudflare' believes CF-Connecting-IP only from a connection in these ranges: anyone who reaches the origin directly can send the header, and would otherwise choose their own address past every allow, deny, ban and rate rule. sdk/platform-php keeps a copy in Firewall::CLOUDFLARE, checked against this file by test/FirewallTest.php, sdk/platform-node one in lib/cloudflare.js, checked by test/cloudflare.test.js, sdk/platform-python one in firewall.py CLOUDFLARE, checked by tests/test_firewall.py, and the collector one in expresscollect/utils/cloudflareRanges.js (flood protection's exemptions and the origin lock), checked by test/floodProtection.test.js, and the backend's in backend/services/firewall/cloudflareRanges.js (whether a domain is behind Cloudflare), checked by Sections/CustomerDash/security/__tests__/floodSettings.test.js. Cloudflare rarely changes the list, but when it does, update every copy.
